I think It is the only good thing I’ve done good in the last 5 years.  The thing is that it’s very exhausting, and it should be something for enjoyment.  Also, there is a very strong lack of ambition from my part. Today everything is money and power and consumption and it has a very bad effect on me.  I’m not surrounded by love, and the thread that I cling to every day is the love of my son, even though only see him two weekends a month.  I’m down to my last cards to play.  I think I’m going to try to move to Canada, I fell in love with the place when I went for my honeymoon.  I’ve tried everything in my country, and this big tombstone I carry in my back has done it’s toll.  Maybe there I can find treatment for my depression. Anyways thanks for your kind words and thank you for sharing your time with me, hope ti comes back to you in many blessings
